metadata.name: Blackout
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A co-op night raid on a blacked-out city block. Fight up the street through the Syndicate checkpoint (or round it through the shop and the house), clear the substation and set the charges, hold it against the counter-attack from the north and the west until they blow, then take the gas station for evac.

objectives.text: Hold the substation until the charges blow
Clear the gas station and reach evac

do.text: Lights out on the whole district. Get through the checkpoint to the substation.
Checkpoint down. The substation is the warehouse up the street.
Substation clear. Set the charges by the transformers.
Charges set! Hold the substation until they blow.
The grid is down! Evac at the gas station, and it is guarded.
Evac is clear. Get under the canopy!
